displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *CVC96 or *MVC96 two-stage furnace covered by IOG-2015L, including Amana AMVC96 and ACVC96: EE7
meaning: Igniter circuit fault. The furnace fails to operate.
causes: Igniter relay fault on the integrated control module
diySteps: Leave the gas valve alone. An igniter fault is not a reason to jumper the valve
Technician: check wiring from the integrated control module to the igniter, the unit ground, and igniter output from the control
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. The chart's igniter checks are electrical.
sourceTitle: Amana and Goodman *CVC96 / *MVC96 two-stage furnace installation instructions (IOG-2015L)
